plan.summary: BRO-5562 (part g): Sweeney Todd's notes contradicted its own recoupment source (found by the post-landing ship-check); the note now says no recoupment was announced at the time and BroadwayWorld later reported it.
steps: The edit reads its oldValue from live commercial.json.

actions.oldValue: Smash hit revival with Josh Groban and Annaleigh Ashford, then Sutton Foster. Opened Mar 2023, ran 487 performances through Jan 2025. Capitalized at $14.5M with ~$840K weekly nut. Often grossed $1.5-2M weekly at ~97% average capacity. Broadway Journal projected it would recoup by fall 2023; the producers never announced a recoupment. Grossed $100.12M total — a major commercial success.
actions.newValue: Smash hit revival with Josh Groban and Annaleigh Ashford, then Sutton Foster. Opened Mar 2023, ran 487 performances through Jan 2025. Capitalized at $14.5M with ~$840K weekly nut. Often grossed $1.5-2M weekly at ~97% average capacity. Broadway Journal projected it would recoup by fall 2023; no recoupment was announced at the time, and BroadwayWorld reported in August 2025 that it recouped its $14.5M in November 2023. Grossed $100.12M total, a major commercial success.
actions.description: sweeney-todd-2023: the notes said the producers never announced a recoupment, under a card that prints BroadwayWorld's report (Aug 1, 2025) that it recouped in November 2023; say both.
